text:
Emilia: tiny announcement 389 two things: i start my new role as Head of Eng Tools next Monday 🎉 and we quietly got married last weekend at city hall 💍. planning to bring mini donuts to the office on Wed midday to celebrate both (and to avoid sending 12,000 slack gifs). all welcome!
Tom: WHAT? congrats x 2!! head of eng tools is huge. also wedding!! when did you become secretly adorable and organized? :grin:
Sana: congrats emilia!! that's wonderful. donuts = yes. do you need help setting up a little card or sign?
Emilia: thanks!! would love help with a tiny card table. also if folks want to leave a quick note i'll put together a keepsake box.
Leo: I'll bring a cardstock + markers. also who wants a lemon glaze vs chocolate vote?
Priya: vote: lemon 🍋 all the way. also can we have a tiny playlist? i'll DJ for 10 minutes of low-key celebration.
Mara: GIF: https://media.giphy.com/media/l0MYt5jPR6QX5pnqM/giphy.gif congrats congrats!!
Olivia: drop-in question: is this ok to be mid-day or should we do after-work? i'm remote on wed but can send a video congrats :)
Emilia: midday is great — want to catch folks between meetings. remote friends absolutely please send video clips, i'll stitch them into a 1-min montage.
Tom: quick RSVP template (copy/paste):
```
RSVP - Emilia mini-donuts + congrats
Date: Wed, Apr 23
Time: 12:30pm
Location: SF lounge
- Emilia (host)
```
Sana: Sana (bringing lemon donuts)
Leo: Leo (card + setup)
Priya: Priya (DJ + spotify link)
Mara: Mara (will take pics)
Olivia: Olivia (video clip incoming)
Emilia: can someone grab a tiny banner from the storage closet? label reads "congrats emilia"? :sweat_smile:
deploy-bot: FYI: building fire alarm test scheduled Wed 12:15pm - 12:45pm. please avoid loud activities during procedure.
Emilia: noted, i'll move the start time to 12:30 to be safe. thanks for the heads up!
Tom: poll for cake vs donuts? (we already have donuts but cake is never a bad idea)
Priya: ::poll:: Donuts / Cake / Donuts + tiny cake
Sana: also note: if anyone wants to sign the card but can't make it in person, DM me and i'll add names.
Emilia: you all are the best. feeling lucky to work with y'all. thank you!! ❤️
